title: Noncrossing Duality and the Geometry of Positive Tropical Linear Spaces
summary: While the positive Grassmannian is deeply understood through the rich combinatorics of plabic graphs and positroid cells, its tropical counterpart, the positive tropical Grassmannian Trop$_{>0}G(k,n)$, has lacked a comparable structural framework for general $k$. Both the global face structure of Trop$_{>0}G(k,n)$ and the internal metric geometry of the tropical linear spaces it parametrizes have remained largely uncharted.
